major_name: Theatre Design, Technology, and Stage Management
college: College of Arts, Media and Design
overview_text: The Bachelor of Fine Arts in Theatre Design, Technology, and Stage Management is an undergraduate degree program designed for students seeking a professional-level education in theatre arts. The program provides an intensive, practice-oriented education that combines classroom instruction with practical, hands-on experiences in real-world settings and equips students with a comprehensive understanding of the artistic, technical, and managerial aspects of theatrical production. Students have an opportunity to excel in creating immersive and innovative live performances by integrating creative design principles with industry-recognized technology and established stage management techniques. The program is tailored for aspiring theatre, television, or film professionals who are passionate about the art of production and management. Ideal candidates include individuals with a strong interest in the visual and technical aspects of theatre; those who possess creative problem-solving skills; and those who aspire to pursue careers as designers, technicians, or stage managers in theatre, television, or film. The program is suitable for students who are dedicated to honing their craft and are eager to contribute to the dynamic world of live performance.
